# tests_r23/mk_ic_keff.py : PURELY RADIATIVE hydrostatic ic_profile for the
# 4.0 Msun He star presupernova envelope, with an EFFECTIVE opacity
#     kappa_eff(r) = f(r) kappa(T,rho),   f = 1.00 (pure radiative, real opacity)
# f = 1 outside the convection zone (0.635 .. 0.967 R), cubic-blended over 0.020 R.
# NO MLT / no subgrid convective flux: radiation carries all of L at every radius.
# Structure: column_sph.py's integration (point-mass hydrostatics, ideal mu = 1.3423 gas
# + a T^4/3, Rosseland table rosseland_he_x0.0_z0.02.txt, grey Eddington atmosphere shot so tau = 2/3 lands on
# R_s = 2.371700e+11 cm, inward in ln p to 0.35 R) with nabla = nabla_rad,eff instead of the MLT
# nabla.  Conversion: make_ic_sph.py (rho kept; T solved from the EOS table dump so that
# p_gas_table(rho,T) + a T^4/3 = p_column) and the NEW density-only radiation taper of
# tests_r14/convert_ic.py, eint = e_gas(rho,T) + w(rho) a T^4, w = 0 below rho 1.0e-11,
# 1 above 1.0e-10, temperature gate off.  Floor atmosphere above the column top from
# tests_r13/mk_tall_ic.py (rho -> 3.0e-13 over 0.005 R, T = the top T, to 1.320 R).
# anchor = rphot ; R_phot(tau=2/3) = 2.371700e+11 cm ; Teff = 48978.8 K
# r[cm]  rho[g/cm^3]  eint[erg/cm^3]
